Made with recycled, water-resistant materials, a wipeable interior and a secure snappable strap, this pacifier case is thoughtfully designed to help every outing feel a little easier. Best for: Everyday parenting, stroller walks, travel, daycare drop-offs and keeping pacifiers or small baby essentials close at hand. Features: Snappable Attachment Strap: Secures easily to diaper bags, strollers or luggage for grab-and-go convenience. Compact Everyday Storage: Keeps pacifiers and other small essentials organized and easy to reach. Recycled Water-Resistant Exterior: Helps protect contents from everyday spills and light moisture. Wipeable Interior: Cleans up quickly after everyday messes. Oeko-Tex® Standard 100 Certified Materials: Made with tested materials for added peace of mind. Lightweight Design: Adds convenient organization without extra bulk. Travel-Ready Convenience: Moves easily from home to daycare to family trips. Made for Daily Parenting: Keeps the essentials close so you're ready for every outing. Note: Stroller Straps sold separately. WARRANTY: This bag is intended for adult use only; it is not intended to be used by children. Do not leave children unattended with this bag. Straps may pose entanglement hazard. Inspect the bag regularly for signs of wear or damage, including loose components. Discontinue use if any parts become detached or damaged. Please use caution when attaching the diaper bag to the handlebars of a baby stroller. Consult your stroller's owner's manual for any restrictions or weight limitations on hanging a diaper bag on a stroller.

description_text: No need to trade style for storage when you have the Luka 15-Inch Laptop Backpack. This award-winning laptop backpack is packed with smart features like a dedicated 15-inch laptop sleeve, a hidden security pocket, and a built-in luggage sleeve. Spacious Pack-for-Anything Layout: Fits your must-haves with room to spare for commuting and weekend plans without the need to switch bags. Travel-Ready Luggage Sleeve: Slides effortlessly onto suitcase handles for smoother airport and travel navigation. Grab-and-Go Convenience: Designed for quick access to your gear so you're never left digging around at the bottom of your bag. Everyday Durable Build: Expertly balances a polished, trendy look with high-quality materials made to handle regular use.

description_text: Skip choosing between a backpack and a duffel, pack it all in the Terra 26L Laptop Duffel Backpack. Designed for everyday commutes, weekend getaways and carry-on travel, our bestselling duffel backpack gives you the flexibility to carry it your way wherever you’re headed. With a padded laptop pocket that fits up to 17 inches, a spacious main compartment and flexible carrying options, the Terra is ready for any trip you choose. Best for: Carry-on travel, commuters with larger laptops, weekend getaways, gym sessions and outdoor trips for anyone who wants an organized, eco-friendly bag that carries like a backpack or duffel. Features: Durable Build: Crafted from recycled ripstop polyester with a snag-resistant lining, it's designed to look great and hold up through every commute, flight and weekend trip. Easy-Access Clamshell Opening: Opens wide like a suitcase so you can pack in seconds and see everything at a glance without digging. Padded 17" Laptop Protection: A dedicated, cushioned compartment that secures laptops up to 17 inches for worry-free travel. Lightweight at Just 2.9 lbs: Delivers massive 26L capacity without adding unnecessary bulk to your journey. Built-In Smart Organization: Interior pockets keep your chargers, toiletries and small essentials separated and exactly where you left them. Compression Straps: Internal straps keep your gear from shifting, ensuring your bag stays balanced and tidy while you're on the move. Travel-Ready Luggage Sleeve: Slides effortlessly onto your suitcase handle for smoother, hands-free navigation through busy terminals. Carry-On Friendly: Perfectly sized to fit in overhead bins on most airlines, making your travel experience as seamless as possible. Versatile 2-Way Carry: Quickly switch between a backpack and a duffel with a detachable, adjustable strap system that adapts to however you want to move.
